'''Alfons Baiker''' (born April 14, 1945 in [[Zürich]]) is a [[Swiss people|Swiss]] [[chemist]] specializing in [[catalysis]]. Baiker studied chemistry at [[ETH Zurich]]. After obtaining his PhD in 1974 he followed several [[Postdoctoral researcher|post-doctoral]] stays at various universities. In 1989 he became a [[Professor (highest academic rank)|full professor]] in catalysis and [[Chemical reaction engineering|reaction engineering]] at ETH where he worked until his retirement in 2010.

== Research ==
Dr. Baiker's research covers a wide range of topics, including:
[[Enantioselective synthesis|asymmetric catalysis]],<ref name="MallatOrglmeister2007">{{cite journal|last1=Mallat|first1=T.|last2=Orglmeister|first2=E.|last3=Baiker|first3=A.|title=Asymmetric Catalysis at Chiral Metal Surfaces|journal=Chemical Reviews|volume=107|issue=11|year=2007|pages=4863–4890|issn=0009-2665|doi=10.1021/cr0683663|pmid=17927256}}</ref> chiral surfaces, [[catalytic oxidation]],<ref name="MallatBaiker2004">{{cite journal|last1=Mallat|first1=Tamas|last2=Baiker|first2=Alfons|title=Oxidation of Alcohols with Molecular Oxygen on Solid Catalysts|journal=Chemical Reviews|volume=104|issue=6|year=2004|pages=3037–3058|issn=0009-2665|doi=10.1021/cr0200116|pmid=15186187}}</ref> utilization of [[carbon dioxide]] in catalytic synthesis,<ref name="Baiker2000">{{cite journal|last1=Baiker|first1=Alfons|title=Utilization of carbon dioxide in heterogeneous catalytic synthesis|journal=Applied Organometallic Chemistry|volume=14|issue=12|year=2000|pages=751–762|issn=0268-2605|doi=10.1002/1099-0739(200012)14:12<751::AID-AOC85>3.0.CO;2-J}}</ref> environmental catalysis,<ref name="RoyBaiker2009">{{cite journal|last1=Roy|first1=Sounak|last2=Baiker|first2=Alfons|title=NOxStorage−Reduction Catalysis: From Mechanism and Materials Properties to Storage−Reduction Performance|journal=Chemical Reviews|volume=109|issue=9|year=2009|pages=4054–4091|issn=0009-2665|doi=10.1021/cr800496f|pmid=19456148}}</ref> reactions in [[supercritical fluid]]s,<ref name="Baiker1999">{{cite journal|last1=Baiker|first1=Alfons|title=Supercritical Fluids in Heterogeneous Catalysis|journal=Chemical Reviews|volume=99|issue=2|year=1999|pages=453–474|issn=0009-2665|doi=10.1021/cr970090z|pmid=11848989}}</ref> flame synthesis of catalysts<ref name="SchimmoellerPratsinis2011">{{cite journal|last1=Schimmoeller|first1=Bjoern|last2=Pratsinis|first2=Sotiris E.|last3=Baiker|first3=Alfons|title=Flame Aerosol Synthesis of Metal Oxide Catalysts with Unprecedented Structural and Catalytic Properties|journal=ChemCatChem|volume=3|issue=8|year=2011|pages=1234–1256|issn=1867-3880|doi=10.1002/cctc.201000425|s2cid=98092646 }}</ref> and in situ [[spectroscopy]] of catalytic surface processes.<ref name="BürgiBaiker2006">{{cite book|last1=Bürgi|first1=Thomas|last2=Baiker|first2=Alfons|title=Attenuated Total Reflection Infrared Spectroscopy of Solid Catalysts Functioning in the Presence of Liquid-Phase Reactants|volume=50|year=2006|pages=227–283|issn=0360-0564|doi=10.1016/S0360-0564(06)50005-7|journal=Advances in Catalysis|isbn=9780120078509}}</ref>
